description: What moved: the biggest inflows and outflows for a flow window (default 1D) and the best and worst total returns over a return window (default 1M), each row dated. ETFIQ publishes no single-day return, so today's movers are flows. Filter by desk or category; funds under min_assets_usd are left out of return lists; leveraged funds are flagged. Then etf_profile or etf_risk_check.

category.description: Optional: only funds in this category.

desk.description: Optional: only funds on this desk, such as leverage.

flow_window.description: The window the flow ranking covers. Default 1D.

limit.description: Most rows in each list, 1 to 25. Default 10.

min_assets_usd.description: Smallest net assets, in US dollars, for the return ranking. Default 100000000; 0 for no floor.

return_window.description: The window the return ranking covers. Default 1M; ETFIQ publishes no single-day return.

name: etf_movers

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
